title: Compatible systems describe sheaves on the coherent total site
statement: Let $I$ be a small category, let $(\mathcal C_i,u_\alpha)$ be the coherent contravariant pseudofunctor of sites and let $\mathcal C_{\mathrm{tot}}$ be the generated-topology total site of [lem-trf-slice-site-total-pseudofunctor]. For each $\alpha:i\to j$, write $f_\alpha:\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal C_i)\to\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal C_j)$ for the geometric morphism induced by $u_\alpha$. Then $\mathrm{Sh}(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{tot}})$ is equivalent to the category of systems $(F_i,t_\alpha)$ consisting of a sheaf $F_i$ on each $\mathcal C_i$ and transition maps $t_\alpha:f_\alpha^{-1}F_j\to F_i$ satisfying $t_{\mathrm{id}}$ and the composition cocycle after inserting the unitors and compositors. Under this equivalence, restriction to a fibre is $F\mapsto F_i$, and a morphism of systems is a family of component maps commuting with every $t_\alpha$.
